instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main landing page structure. Use Shadcn for the course detail modal (Dialog), Tabs within the modal, and Accordions for the rites/rituals.

The Hero section should feel like an editorial magazine spread. Large serif typography (`Cormorant Garamond`), subtle fade-in animations, and generous negative space. Do not use standard center-aligned Bootstrap-style hero.

For the Course Cards, use the `cards.course_card` classes. The image should take up the top 50-60% of the card (`aspect-[4/5]`), with the content padded beautifully below. Use the `badges.premium` class for the pricing tag.

The Course Detail Modal (Dialog) is the core feature. Make it large (`max-w-4xl`). The header should have a subtle background texture or soft color, followed by Shadcn Tabs for the 7 sections (The Rites, Rituals, Embodiment, Prepare & Integrate, Daily Practice, 40-Day Journey, Safety).
Customize the Shadcn Tabs heavily using the classes provided in `components.tabs` to avoid the default grey background block. We want clean, elegant underlines.
Include a sticky or prominent 'Unlock Course' CTA inside the modal with a price tag, designed using the `buttons.primary` class.
Ensure all text color contrasts meet accessibility standards. Use `#3D2E2B` for main headings and `#7A706D` for body text.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements, such as `data-testid='course-card-munay-ki'`, `data-testid='unlock-course-button'`, and `data-testid='tab-rituals'`.
